fish.look: Long spear bill and a vast sail fin taller than its body, dusk-violet and sown with ink spots like a star chart; slim silver flank with lavender bars; crescent tail.
fish.play: Leaper. Raises the sail and dances: breach after breach, tail-walks, bill-slashing head-shakes, long fast runs between.
fish.journal: It raises a sail the colour of dusk and still goes nowhere it is told.
fish.haunt: Old water only: the Drift Line, at the surface. A sail cutting the swell; nervous water where it herds bait.

fish.name: Castaway Pike
fish.favours: Predator: Glimmer Spoon (it takes a jig), Cut Strip.
fish.look: Long, lean, ink-violet pike of the open sea: jutting underjaw, long fang teeth, a long low spiny dorsal, finlets before a forked tail; silver belly, lavender sheen.
fish.play: Thrasher. Comes in packs: slashing head-shakes, twisting short runs and sudden slack; its teeth fray the line.
fish.journal: It follows wrecks and rafts alike, patient as weather.
fish.haunt: Night water: the Beam, where the lamp's light crosses the swell, in packs. Mid-water. Sign: nervous water, then a strike splash.

fish.name: Pinstripe Tuna
fish.look: Stout bullet of a tuna: ink-violet back, silver belly ruled with four or five dark pinstripes; crescent tail on a thin stalk, small finlets.
fish.play: Runner. A drumming, tail-beating run straight down and away; short, fast and tireless.
fish.journal: It never stops swimming, even asleep. Especially asleep.
fish.haunt: Surface schools in open water. Nervous water.

fish.name: Scribbleback Mackerel
fish.look: Small, slim tuna-shaped fish; the back is ink scribbles on lavender-silver, like a page of quick handwriting; pearl belly, forked tail, finlets.
fish.play: Darter. Frantic, buzzing zigzags; over in a moment.
fish.journal: Its back is covered in writing. Nobody has read a mackerel in years.
fish.haunt: Dense surface schools in open water. Nervous water.

fish.name: Grey Latchfin
fish.look: Deep grey-lavender diamond with a tiny beaked mouth, a locking spine on the brow and tall twin fins it sculls with; one ink blotch at the fin root.
fish.play: Steady. Sculls in stubborn circles and locks its spine; small mouth, light takes.
fish.journal: It locks its spine upright, like a door bolted from the inside.
fish.haunt: Near the surface around the Lamp Rock and under drifting wreckage: open water and day water. Rise ring.

fish.name: Fadegold
fish.look: High blunt forehead, a crest fin from brow to tail, a body tapering to a deep fork; candle-gold flank with lavender freckles, dusk-violet back. The gold fades grey in the hand.
fish.play: Leaper. Lit up and wild: greyhounding leaps, tail-walks and fast surface runs.
fish.journal: Its gold goes out in your hands, like a candle carried into the wind.
fish.haunt: Under floating wreckage and weed in open water, at the surface. Strike splash; a gold flash under the drift.

fish.name: Soot Jack
fish.look: Soot-black jack with a steep, slightly hollowed forehead, long sickle fins and a row of black plates before the tail; the eye is a pale lavender ring.
fish.play: Runner. Dives down the rock face and circles side-on; dour, heavy, no leaps.
fish.journal: Black as a snuffed wick, and about as cheerful.
fish.haunt: Day water: the steep sides of the Lamp Rock, mid to deep. Strike splash.

fish.name: Ambersickle Tuna
fish.look: Heavy torpedo with long scythe-shaped second dorsal and anal fins in candle amber, amber finlets, an ink-violet back and a pale gold stripe along the flank.
fish.play: Runner. One huge dive straight down, then wide grinding circles under the raft; heavy tow, a last stand.
fish.journal: It has crossed the whole sea twice and still seems late for something.
fish.haunt: Blue water, surface to deep: open water, and the Drift Line for the old ones. Strike splash; nervous water where it pins bait.

fish.name: Starbar Lancer
fish.favours: Predator: Cut Strip first, then Ember Roe or the Glimmer Spoon.
fish.look: Slim spear-billed fish with a tall pointed dorsal and a crescent tail; ink-violet back, silver flank crossed by pale lavender bars that light up when it is roused.
fish.play: Leaper. Lights its bars and goes: tail-walks, greyhounding leaps, bill-shaking head-shakes, long surface runs.
fish.journal: When it is angry its stripes light up. It is nearly always angry.
fish.haunt: Open blue water and the Drift Line, at the surface. A fin and a tail tip cutting the swell; strike splash.

fish.name: The Long Winter
fish.favours: Its own bait only (a new legend bait: an Old Ration, the older the better).
fish.look: A grey, cigar-shaped bulk with a short blunt snout, small fins set far back, and no hurry. Frost-pale mottling; each milky eye trails one small pale thread that glows like a candle end.
fish.play: Legend, a sulker. No runs: a slow, endless weight rising from half a mile down; long stills, heavy rolls, two last stands.
fish.journal: It was old when the kingdom was built. It has not hurried once since.
fish.haunt: The crown: the Half-Mile Line, the deepest water under the ice. No sign but the float going down, very slowly.

fish.name: Icedoor Flounder
fish.look: A flatfish as wide as a door: long diamond body, both eyes on the dark side, big jaws, a crescent tail. Slate-violet above with pale frost marbling; the underside is white as lamp-lit ice.
fish.play: Sinker. Dead weight, then planing dives straight back to the bottom, again and again; it slams its tail at the raft. A last stand.
fish.journal: A door of ice lying on the seabed. Knock, and it comes up swinging.
fish.haunt: Old water only: the sand and gravel shelves of the Fjord Floor, bottom, on the turn of the tide. A boil; a door-sized shadow lifting.

fish.name: Greybeard Cod
fish.look: Pot-bellied, big-headed fish with three dorsal fins, a square tail and one pale chin whisker; stone-grey freckled lavender-brown, a pale line along the side.
fish.play: Steady. Heavy head-nodding pulls and one dive; it comes up wide-mouthed and resigned.
fish.journal: One whisker on its chin, and the look of someone who has seen winters.
fish.haunt: Bottom to mid in open water; under the Lantern Hole at night. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Thumbprint Cod
fish.look: Slimmer cod shape with a tall pointed first dorsal, a short chin whisker and a black side line; pewter-violet, with one ink thumbprint behind the gill.
fish.play: Darter. Quick fluttering tugs and a soft mouth; a short, light play.
fish.journal: Somebody once picked it up to look, and it has kept the thumbprint.
fish.haunt: Bottom over sand and shell, open water. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Ashline Cod
fish.favours: Predator: Glimmer Spoon (it takes a jig).
fish.look: Streamlined cod shape with a jutting lower jaw, three dorsal fins and a forked tail; charcoal back, pewter belly, one straight ash-pale line from gill to tail.
fish.play: Runner. Dives hard for the bottom again and again; strong for its size.
fish.journal: Dark as cold ash, with one pale line to show where the fire was.
fish.haunt: Mid-water schools along the cliffs, open water. Nervous water.

fish.name: Emberspot Flounder
fish.look: A flat oval lying on its side, both eyes on top, fringed all round with fin; stone-brown upper side dotted with candle-amber spots, white beneath.
fish.play: Sinker. Planes flat against the pull and sticks to the bottom, then flutters up like a falling leaf.
fish.journal: It lies on the sand wearing a few small embers, hoping to pass for a hearth.
fish.haunt: Sandy shallows, bottom: open water and the Net Racks. A puff of sand; bubble trail.

fish.name: Wickstripe Rockfish
fish.look: Stout, spiny, big-eyed rockfish, ink-black freckled with pale lavender, with one broad candle-amber stripe from the dorsal down along the side.
fish.play: Sinker. Darts into a crevice and braces its spines; a short tug of war.
fish.journal: Black, with one amber stripe, like a candle seen through a keyhole.
fish.haunt: Rock crevices, mid to bottom: open water and the Net Racks. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Rosedeep Rockfish
fish.look: Spiny, heavy-headed rockfish with very large dark eyes and a jutting chin; nebula pink all over, paler below, one dusky smudge on the gill cover.
fish.play: Sinker. A long, slow lift from deep water with small head-shakes; it arrives looking startled.
fish.journal: Brought up from the dark, it blushes all over at being seen.
fish.haunt: Deep water, a hundred metres down: open water and under the Lantern Hole. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Hemstitch Cod
fish.look: Thick, eel-like cod with one chin whisker and a single long fin from shoulder to tail, edged ink-black and hemmed with a pale stitch line; stone-brown, lavender belly.
fish.play: Sulker. Backs into the rocks and sits; slow, heavy, twisting pulls.
fish.journal: Every fin is hemmed in pale thread, by someone careful and long gone.
fish.haunt: Deep rocky ground, bottom: open water and the Fjord Floor. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Bouldermouth
fish.look: Long mottled body behind an oversized head and a wide mouth of needle teeth; a long spiny dorsal; stone-grey blotched dusk-violet, the inside of the mouth pale lavender.
fish.play: Thrasher. Clamps on and refuses to let go; big head-shakes, then a dive for the boulders.
fish.journal: Mostly head, and the head is mostly mouth. It guards its nest all winter.
fish.haunt: Boulder reefs, bottom: open water and the edge of the Fjord Floor. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Bellrope Cod
fish.look: A cod drawn out long as a bell rope: one chin whisker, a short first dorsal and a very long second; bronze-brown marbled lavender, fins edged white.
fish.play: Sinker. Heavy, writhing pulls from deep rough ground; it backs into the wreckage to wrap the line.
fish.journal: Long as a bell rope. Pull, and something far below pulls back.
fish.haunt: Old water: wreckage and rough ground on the Fjord Floor, bottom. Bubble trail.

fish.name: Coalwing Skate
fish.look: Diamond wings and a long pointed snout; a thick tail with thorns and two small fins near its tip. Coal-black above and below, dusted with pale star-pores.
fish.play: Sulker. Planes its wings against the current and hangs like a kite; a long, heavy lift from the deep, with stills.
fish.journal: Black on both sides, like a letter nobody has written yet.
fish.haunt: Old water: the Fjord Floor, very deep, bottom. A slow boil when a big one lifts.

curiosities.name: Potlid Turtle
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A flat leathery shell like a pot lid, a long neck, a snorkel nose, paddle feet. Stone-white and slate with ink rings.
curiosities.journal: Takes the bait meant for the monster, every time, without shame.
curiosities.where: The Boulder Garden and the Last Pyre at night; the bends of the Slough. It takes the giants' own baits.

inspiredBy.common: Indian narrow-headed softshell turtle (giant softshell turtle)

inspiredBy.scientific: Trionychidae (Wikipedia: Indian flapshell turtle, Lissemys punctata)

curiosities.name: Little Logjaw
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A small, cross, armoured thing with a long jaw, pale amber eyes and a ridged tail, dusk-brown and pale stone.
curiosities.journal: Pairs of amber eyes sit at the edge of the lantern light every night. This one came closer.
curiosities.where: Rootgate Creek after dark, on a Cut Strip in the shallows. Pairs of eyes at the edge of the light are atmosphere, always.

curiosities.name: The Stone Lodger
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A broad flat head, pin-prick eyes, a mouth like a seam, four stubby legs, loose folded skin and a paddle tail. Wet-stone slate mottled with ink.
curiosities.journal: Has rented the same rock for a hundred years and never paid.
curiosities.where: Under one boulder in the Boulder Garden, at night, on a Bone Jig lowered at the rock.

curiosities.name: Mudlark Crab
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A wide smooth slate shell and two heavy ivory claws tipped rust.
curiosities.journal: Steals your bait, then comes up to see who to thank.
curiosities.where: The mud among the roots of the Salt Gate, any hour, on any bottom bait.

curiosities.name: Paper-Lantern Jelly
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A square bell with four tassels, pale lavender with an amber core. It does not sting: nothing in this game hurts.
curiosities.journal: A lantern somebody let go of. It is still looking for the hand.
curiosities.where: Lamp Row at night, drawn by the Lantern Lure.

curiosities.name: Guttering Squid
curiosities.look: Not a fish. A long mantle and eight arms that flicker nebula pink and bone white like a candle in a draught. They come in packs.
curiosities.journal: It goes pink, then white, then pink, like a candle deciding.
curiosities.where: The Beam at night, on a jig or the Lantern Lure.

curiosities.name: The Long Coil
curiosities.look: Never hooked. A shadow four rafts long slides under the raft and is gone.
curiosities.journal: Something long went under the raft. It did not stop.
curiosities.where: Rootgate Creek, once in a long while. It costs no bait and no good bite and writes one Journal line.

curiosities.name: The Unlit Lance
curiosities.look: Never landed. A spear-billed fish of pure ink with a short heavy bill; it shows only as a gap in the reflected stars when it jumps.
curiosities.journal: Everyone has hooked it once. In every telling it is a little longer.
curiosities.where: The Unlit Mile at night. Rarely a Trophy-class play there ends at the raft with a thrown hook and this got-away note; it never lands, takes no slot and costs only the cast.

newBodyPlans.name: catfish
newBodyPlans.what: Broad flat head over a wide mouth, whiskers, scaleless skin, small eyes, a low body tapering to the tail.
newBodyPlans.params: whisker pairs (0 to 4) and length; head (shovel, duck bill, bullet, bony shield, jutting jaw); tail (fork, round, threads, eel taper with a long belly fin); fatty fin; side plates and locking spines; eye height.
newBodyPlans.needs: A new builder from the pike profile with a flattened head; reuse the barbels helper from the carp; side-plate and spine extras.

newBodyPlans.name: disc
newBodyPlans.what: River ray: a near-round disc, eyes on two small turrets, a tail shorter than the disc or a thin whip.
newBodyPlans.params: roundness, thickness, tail (stout sting, stub, thread, whip, thorns), back pattern (eye-rings, coins, stars, honeycomb, mottle, moon rings, a meadow).
newBodyPlans.needs: The built ray with a rounder width profile and a tail parameter; the built ray stays for kite and diamond rays.

newBodyPlans.name: dogtooth
newBodyPlans.what: Toothed river hunter: a torpedo body, one dorsal at mid-back and a small fatty fin, a big bony head, teeth that show with the mouth shut.
newBodyPlans.params: teeth (meshing daggers, two lower sabres, a tight row, dog teeth); head (steep, bulldog, salmon); body (slim to log-round); tail (fork or paddle); side lines.
newBodyPlans.needs: The perch profile stretched, with a teeth mesh row outside the lips.

newBodyPlans.name: bream
newBodyPlans.what: A deep, thin, plate-shaped body, half to almost as tall as it is long, a blunt head and a belly keel.
newBodyPlans.params: depth; jaw (underslung with one row of triangle teeth, small mouth with square teeth, toothless); eye size; tail (fork or scythe); ear-flap.
newBodyPlans.needs: The perch with a depth parameter and a jaw parameter.

newBodyPlans.name: shark
newBodyPlans.what: A torpedo with the mouth under the snout, five or six gill slits, a stiff triangular first dorsal, pectoral wings and a tail with a long upper lobe.
newBodyPlans.params: snout (blunt, round, pointed, square); girth; second-dorsal height; gill count; flank bars; a sleeper setting with small fins set far back.
newBodyPlans.needs: A new builder. The sawfish is built on it.

newBodyPlans.name: sawfish
newBodyPlans.what: The shark plan flattened in front like a ray, with a long flat saw.
newBodyPlans.params: saw length as a share of the body; teeth per side; a glow point per tooth.
newBodyPlans.needs: Shark plus a flattened head and a saw extra.

newBodyPlans.name: gar
newBodyPlans.what: A long armoured cylinder in diamond scales, a toothy snout, back and belly fins set far back by a round tail.
newBodyPlans.needs: The pike with a snout parameter and a diamond-scale texture.

newBodyPlans.name: trout
newBodyPlans.what: Spindle body, one dorsal at mid-length, a small fatty fin, a square or lightly forked tail.
newBodyPlans.params: hooked jaw with dog teeth; humped back; tall sail fin; flat wolf head; blunt snout.
newBodyPlans.needs: The minnow profile with a fatty fin and a jaw parameter.

newBodyPlans.name: snakehead
newBodyPlans.what: A long cylinder, a flat scaled head with the eyes far forward, one ribbon fin above and one below, a round tail.
newBodyPlans.params: false eye on the tail; bony head plate; four fleshy paddle fins and a wrapped pointed tail (lungfish).
newBodyPlans.needs: The eel profile thickened, with ribbon fins top and bottom.

newBodyPlans.name: lamprey
newBodyPlans.what: An eel body with no jaws and no paired fins: a round sucker disc ringed with teeth and seven gill holes in a row.
newBodyPlans.needs: The eel with a mouth parameter.

newBodyPlans.name: jack
newBodyPlans.what: A deep, flat-sided body with a steep forehead, long sickle pectorals, a row of bony plates along a narrow tail stalk and a deeply forked tail.
newBodyPlans.params: forehead (steep, anvil); depth; eye size; a full-length crest fin with a tapering body (the Fadegold).
newBodyPlans.needs: The perch with a tail-stalk keel and sickle fins.

newBodyPlans.name: tuna
newBodyPlans.what: A rigid teardrop, pointed head, two dorsals, finlets above and below a thin keeled tail stalk, a stiff crescent tail.
newBodyPlans.params: girth; sickle-fin length; belly stripes or back scribbles.
newBodyPlans.needs: The minnow profile with finlets and a crescent tail.

newBodyPlans.name: billfish
newBodyPlans.what: A deep-shouldered body tapering to a keeled tail stalk and crescent tail; the upper jaw drawn out into a spear.
newBodyPlans.params: bill length; dorsal (sail taller than the body, tall point, low); flank bars that can light.
newBodyPlans.needs: The tuna plus a bill and a sail fin.

newBodyPlans.name: cod
newBodyPlans.what: Soft, big-headed, pot-bellied, with three dorsals and two anal fins in a row, a square tail and one chin whisker.
newBodyPlans.params: a long setting that stretches the body and joins the fins (two dorsals, or one continuous fin).
newBodyPlans.needs: The carp profile with three dorsal fins and one barbel.

newBodyPlans.name: flatfish
newBodyPlans.what: An oval or diamond body lying on one side, both eyes on top, a fringe of fin all round, coloured above and white below.
newBodyPlans.needs: A new builder: a flattened disc with both eyes on one face; it hangs like a plate when held up.

newBodyPlans.name: softshell
newBodyPlans.what: Curiosity only. A flat leathery shell, long neck, snorkel nose, paddle feet.

newBodyPlans.name: salamander
newBodyPlans.what: Curiosity only. A broad flat head, four stubby legs, loose skin folds and a paddle tail.

newBodyPlans.name: squid
newBodyPlans.what: Curiosity only. A long mantle, eight arms and two tentacles, a colour flicker.
newBodyPlans.needs: The jelly plan run backwards, or one small model.
